title: LDAP Authentication Middleware Config
description: Configuration for the LDAP / Active Directory authentication middleware plugin. Credentials arrive as HTTP Basic, the user entry is located with a search, and the password is verified with a bind as that entry.

url.description: Directory URL: ldap://host[:port] or ldaps://host[:port]. Use ldaps:// or starttls so passwords are not sent in the clear.

bind_dn.description: Service-account DN used for the user and group searches. Omit for an anonymous search.

bind_password.description: Service-account password. Supports secret references (e.g. env://LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD).

starttls.description: Upgrade a plaintext ldap:// connection with StartTLS before binding. Fails closed if the server refuses.

allow_plaintext.description: Send passwords over a plaintext ldap:// connection without StartTLS. Refused by the gateway unless set; intended for test directories only.

user_base_dn.description: Base DN of the user search, e.g. ou=people,dc=example,dc=com

user_filter.description: User search filter. {username} is replaced with the escaped Basic-auth username (RFC 4515).

user_attr.description: Attribute of the user entry used as the consumer id in x-auth-consumer. Falls back to the submitted username when the entry lacks it.

group_attr.description: Attribute of the user entry holding group DNs (e.g. memberOf). Used when group_base_dn is unset.

group_name_attr.description: Attribute naming each group entry in group-search mode. Falls back to the first RDN of the group DN when the entry lacks it.

group_base_dn.description: Base DN of a group search. When set, groups come from entries matching group_filter instead of group_attr on the user entry.

group_filter.description: Group search filter. {dn} and {username} are replaced with the escaped user DN and username.

group_name_from_dn.description: Emit the first RDN value of each group DN (e.g. admins from cn=admins,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com) instead of the full DN in x-auth-consumer-groups.

required_groups.description: Groups the user must belong to (any of). Empty means no group requirement; use the acl middleware for richer policy.

timeout.description: Per-operation timeout in seconds for directory searches and binds.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long a verified credential (and its groups) or a rejected credential is remembered before the directory is consulted again. 0 disables caching.

realm.description: Authentication realm shown in the WWW-Authenticate challenge.

strip_credentials.description: Remove the Authorization header before forwarding to upstream.
